sections.content: Use future, conditional and subjunctive structures to predict, imagine alternatives and discuss uncertain possibilities.

items.spanish: Es posible que cambie la situación.
items.english: It is possible that the situation will change.

items.spanish: Si tuviera más tiempo, prepararía otra propuesta.
items.english: If I had more time, I would prepare another proposal.

items.spanish: Es posible que la situación cambie, y si hubiera más recursos, mejoraría más rápido.
items.english: It is possible that the situation will change, and if there were more resources, it would improve faster.
